description: This PHP class 'WorkWeekModel' is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically within the Leave plugin's API model. It implements serialization for the 'WorkWeek' entity, exposing properties for each day of the week as an API schema definition.

classes.name: WorkWeekModel
classes.description: API model class that wraps 'WorkWeek' entity to provide serialized output for API responses, including day-of-week properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a 'WorkWeek' entity and sets up property filters for serialization.
